method: 14 sampled frames across the clip; final native frame additionally inspected for shots 08 and 12; AVFoundation decode and audio level checks.
observations: The train stays lengthwise on the rails. Riley and the train travel in the same direction while the coastline streams beneath them.
Riley gains relative to the train and reaches its nose near the end.
limitations: The ending does not show a clear full-body pass with the requested three-body-length lead; only her upper body is marginally ahead of the nose.
Riley drifts toward the rail-side boundary instead of keeping a consistent offset in the separate running lane.
The tiny overhead figure cannot establish face, chrome detail or footfall quality.
Review used 14 sampled frames plus technical decoding; no full real-time playback or independent listening review. Native audio is preserved and needs sound-design/mix review.
